title: needed sewn after first washing but still soft and feels like cotton
text: needed sewn after first washing but still soft and feels like cotton. I still think its worth the money because i've been ending up with a lot of things that say its 100% cotton and its some synthetic blend and falls apart after first washing. I would buy it again because its very soft. They do need to give more material in the seems so you don't end up with holes after washing. Also true to color, with a king sized bed it saves comforters from constant washing.
